# Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS)

> > The Royal Pharmaceutical Society is the professional membership body for pharmacists and pharmacy in Great Britain, providing education, training, and professional development resources.

RPS supports pharmacists across England, Scotland, and Wales through its learning platform (RPS Learn), the Pharmaceutical Journal, and Pharmaceutical Press publications. The organization operates offices in London, Cardiff, and Edinburgh to serve the pharmacy profession.

## Key Topics

- Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS)
- RPS Learn
- Pharmaceutical Journal
- Pharmaceutical Press

- Continuing Professional Development (CPD)
- Clinical training
- Prescribing
- Patient care
- Pharmacy careers
- Professional membership
- England, Scotland, Wales offices
